Looking for a job where you can stay active and work with fresh food? At Bonfait in Denekamp, we’re looking for motivated Production Workers who love to roll up their sleeves. No experience? No problem! If you’re eager to learn and ready to work, we’d love to meet you.

- 06:00 AM – 2:45 PM
- 2:45 PM – 12:00 AM

Wat zoeken wij
We don’t ask for diplomas — we’re looking for energy, reliability and a hands-on attitude.
You are:
- Available full-time and willing to work 2 shifts
- Able to speak basic Dutch, English or German
- A team player who enjoys active work
- Precise and hygienic in your working style
- Motivated and not afraid to get your hands dirty

Wat bieden wij
- A starting salary of €15,90 per hour (excl. shift bonus)
- 133% shift bonus after 6:00 PM = €21,15 per hour
- Delicious Bonfait meals for just €2 each
- No transport? Use a 4 Minutes bike or scooter
- Growth opportunities within a fast-growing company

Over het bedrijf
Bonfait is a leading producer of fresh, ready-made meal solutions, located in Denekamp. With a passion for food and a strong focus on innovation, Bonfait delivers high-quality products to both retail and food service on a daily basis. You pick up your cart full of flowers and distribute them to the carts of customers. You use a headset to hear exactly where your flowers need to go. You lift beautiful plants and flowers from your cart to the customer’s cart. You also check orders and help with other logistics tasks. You work in a nice flow and see the results of your work immediately.Do you want to be active, see results quickly, and work in an enthusiastic team? Join us! - You can work for at least 7 months

- You speak good Dutch or English

- You can provide a certificate of good conduct (we pay for it)
-
